selection: SHA-256 of the decoded seed followed by each UTF-8 component prefixed with a NUL byte. In P and Q rank eligible PRs by ('PR', batch, canonicalPR, parent, fix), then canonicalPR, and take the first five. In R rank eligible canonical repositories by ('project', 'R', repository), then repository. Take the first ten repositories, and their first eligible PR by the same PR ranking. No replacement, retries, draws until success or substitution for a preparation stop.
reference: In the original comparison order choose the first Intent row. Preserve all its variant deployments, registered side scopes, arguments, retained receiver/argument requirements, ordered actions and public projections. Keep every Challenge, Control and further Intent as a separate row. Join actuals to expectations by deployment, question, side and ordered field. Preserve unpredicted sides and baseline contradictions.
score: One success per PR only when ranking picked the independently equivalent primary, the concrete tested public history instantiates its typed input and binding obligations, all registered fields on every required side and deployment were independently qualified, and finite disposition matches the reference. A correct parent baseline plus a wrong fix prediction is a refutation. An incorrect required parent baseline is open. A missing registration for a side stays unpredicted. A distinct route requires witnessed correspondence, and equality of names or final strings cannot establish it. Unresolved equivalence gets no credit.
diagnostics: After all 20 cold predictions are sealed, open a fresh test-assisted and a fresh reviewed view per case from the identical source. Each arm seals predictions before measurement. Keep PR-level cold, test-assisted, reviewed and subsequent explicitly labelled repairs. Count semantic matches in the first three separately from qualified ranked alternatives; report other claims and all controls separately. A stop or safety abstention is a scored miss, with its stage and cause.
safety: Retain any selected case requiring reproduction of a real security vulnerability in the fixed denominator as a scoped abstention. Do not run or distribute its triggering fixtures, upstream tests, caller or source-level reproduction.
accounting: Publish the exact fractions and paired differences. The historical corpus authorship and common bulk replay supply reference measurements for all 110. Exact prior PR, landing/explicit cherry-pick, ordered commit pair, numbered generator handoff, frozen transfer, and shared product or change-plan qualification exclude a case. Mere presence in the historical benchmark or same repository/package is reported separately and does not exclude a different PR. Two reserved entries use only the URL list and bare worktree HEADs.
